# SA Tender Guide v2 — Machine-Readable Rules Table

Release date: 2026-08-18. Sources: `sa-tender-guide.md` (guide v1 core gates/kill rules) and `findings-report.md` (24-item v2 edit list + 10 confirmed contradictions from the ~1,200-pack corpus expansion). Ocids abbreviated in the source report are given in full `ocds-9t57fa-NNNNNN` form. `guide-v2` = rule sourced from the adjudicated findings/guide rather than a single cited pack.

| rule_id | type | trigger | rule | severity | source_packs |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| GATE-CSD | gate | always | Active CSD registration with current banking/director/address details is required in effectively every full pack, and several buyers disqualify if not registered at closing time; check per pack whether the FULL or summary report is demanded and its freshness window (7 days-3 months). | fatal | guide-v2 |
| GATE-TCS | gate | always | A current SARS TCS PIN is required in every pack with bid conditions (one per JV partner and per subcontractor); some buyers invalidate at closing, most verify at award with a 7-working-day cure window. | fatal | guide-v2 |
| GATE-DEFAULTERS | gate | always | Listing of the bidder or any director/member/shareholder/trustee on the Register for Tender Defaulters or List of Restricted Suppliers is automatic, no-cure disqualification. | fatal | guide-v2 |
| GATE-STATE-EMP | gate | always | Bids from state employees or companies with state-employed directors are barred unless executive-authority approval for outside remunerative work is obtained and filed with the bid. | fatal | guide-v2 |
| GATE-CIPC-AUTH | gate | always | CIPC registration documents, director ID copies, share certificates, and a board resolution proving signing authority must be submitted, certified within 90 days from originals (no copies of certified copies at checklist buyers). | fatal | guide-v2 |
| GATE-BBBEE-PREQUAL | gate | buyer-specific:Eskom/TASEZ/OBP-style | Where the pack places the B-BBEE certificate/level inside a pass/fail pre-qualification or administrative-compliance table (e.g. minimum Level 3), missing or expired proof disqualifies outright — the "still submit" rule does not apply. | fatal | ocds-9t57fa-165629; ocds-9t57fa-164991; ocds-9t57fa-164946 |
| GATE-CIDB | gate | regime:CIDB | The exact CIDB class and grade must be active and in good standing at close and through validity (default assumption), unless the pack's eligibility clause grants a "capable of being registered within 21 working days" grace period — check before self-eliminating. | fatal | ocds-9t57fa-165629; ocds-9t57fa-165711; guide-v2 |
| GATE-RATES | gate | regime:MBD | Municipal rates-and-taxes clearance is required for the company AND every director; the arrears threshold is buyer-specific (1-3 months), and some buyers demand the clearance only from the recommended bidder rather than at submission. | fatal | ocds-9t57fa-165524; ocds-9t57fa-165711; guide-v2 |
| GATE-COIDA | gate | buyer-specific:works/site-based-services | A COIDA Letter of Good Standing (or commissioned no-employee exemption affidavit) is required — bid-stage disqualifier at some buyers, verified online on evaluation day at others, contract-signing condition elsewhere. | fatal | guide-v2 |
| GATE-SECTOR-REG | gate | buyer-specific:regulated-sectors | Named statutory registrations (PSIRA, NHBRC, ECSA/SACQSP/SACPCMP, LPC, HPCSA, OEM authorisations, waste licences) are pass/fail wherever they appear, certified and current, in the exact class/grade, often for named individuals as well as the firm. | fatal | guide-v2 |
| GATE-JV | gate | always | A JV must have a signed JV agreement before submission (a letter of intent is expressly rejected), notarised/authenticated with all-partner power of attorney where the pack demands it, plus per-partner CSD/TCS/SBD4 and the lead-partner-within-one-grade CIDB rule. | fatal | guide-v2 |
| GATE-BRIEFING | gate | buyer-specific:where-compulsory | Attendance at a compulsory briefing/site meeting — on time (lateness counts as absence) and registered in the exact bidding entity's name, with Certificate of Attendance filed as a returnable — is pass/fail in every case where the briefing is compulsory. | fatal | guide-v2 |
| GATE-MBD5-AFS | gate | regime:MBD | Municipal procurement above R10 million requires the MBD 5 declaration plus three years of audited annual financial statements (or AFS since incorporation). | fatal | guide-v2 |
| GATE-VETTING | gate | buyer-specific:SIU/SANRAL/Transnet/DBSA/SAPS/DHA/BMA | Post-scoring security/integrity vetting — SSA screening, CONFIDENTIAL/SECRET clearances for staff and subcontractors, PEP/Procure checks, SAP-91 original fingerprints for National Key Points, SA-citizen-only personnel clauses — can disqualify irrespective of points scored. | fatal | ocds-9t57fa-164363; ocds-9t57fa-164839; guide-v2 |
| GATE-POPIA | gate | buyer-specific:cross-sector | A POPIA consent/processing form is a mandatory returnable at multiple buyers across construction, municipal, and SOE packs — omission is a missing-returnable kill where demanded. | fatal | guide-v2 |
| GATE-INTEGRITY-PACT | gate | buyer-specific:Gauteng-Treasury/Eskom/Transnet | A buyer-branded Integrity Pact must be signed and returned IN ADDITION to SBD/MBD 9; the related DPIP/FPPO politically-exposed-persons declaration (SANRAL Form A5, Transnet) can render the tender invalid if omitted. | fatal | guide-v2 |
| KILL-LATE | kill | always | Late submission is fatal with zero tolerance measured in seconds; the sole confirmed exception is DBSA's discretion where lateness was the buyer's own fault, box access was denied, or a major incident occurred — never plan on it. | fatal | ocds-9t57fa-165115; guide-v2 |
| KILL-RETURNABLE | kill | always | Missing, incomplete, or unsigned mandatory returnables kill the bid; build the master returnables checklist from a page-by-page sweep, treat the pack's own checklist as a floor, and never assume a cure window exists. | fatal | guide-v2 |
| KILL-FRAUD-PREF | kill | always | A fraudulent preference-points claim carries disqualification, contract cancellation, up to 10-year restriction from all public-sector business, and criminal referral. | fatal | guide-v2 |
| KILL-SBD4 | kill | always | A false, incomplete, or partially blank SBD/MBD 4 disclosure — including failure to disclose all CSD-registered companies linked to any director — invalidates the bid, with blacklisting risk. | fatal | guide-v2 |
| KILL-COLLUSION | kill | always | Collusion, attempts to influence officials, or an untrue SBD/MBD 9 independent-bid certificate disqualifies; approaching officials other than the designated contact is itself a disqualifying offence at several buyers. | fatal | guide-v2 |
| KILL-INK | kill | buyer-specific:recurring-template | Tipp-Ex, pencil, wrong ink, or uninitialled corrections are per-se disqualifiers at many buyers (recurring but not "half" — 17.5% black-ink mention rate), while others run graduated consequence regimes — check the pack's correction rule. | fatal | ocds-9t57fa-165643; ocds-9t57fa-165128; guide-v2 |
| KILL-CHANNEL | kill | always | Submission via any channel other than the prescribed one (wrong box, fax/email at physical buyers, off-platform at portal buyers) is void; the rare exception (SIU accepts faxed/emailed tenders) proves channel rules are per-pack. | fatal | ocds-9t57fa-164363; guide-v2 |
| KILL-PRICE-BLANKS | kill | always | Blanks, dashes, or "N/A" in the pricing schedule count as unpriced and can invalidate the whole tender (write R0.00 deliberately; honour NO QUOTE blocks); a rare buyer defaults blanks to N/A instead — the strict default stands. | fatal | ocds-9t57fa-164442; guide-v2 |
| KILL-UNSIGNED | kill | always | An unsigned Form of Offer/C1.1, or missing proof of signing authority (board resolution), renders the tender non-responsive and is not curable. | fatal | guide-v2 |
| KILL-QUALIFIED | kill | always | A qualified bid or own conditions attached to the offer or price is non-responsive and cannot be cured — never qualify the bid (see DELTA-V2-10 for the single boilerplate caveat). | fatal | guide-v2 |
| KILL-RETYPED | kill | always | Retyped, reformatted, or substituted forms in place of the official issued forms — or removed/inserted pages — kill the bid; return the complete document and mark inapplicable sections N/A. | fatal | guide-v2 |
| KILL-CURE-MISS | kill | always | Where a cure window exists (24 hours-7 days), missing it converts a curable defect into disqualification — monitor the named contact email daily after submission. | fatal | guide-v2 |
| KILL-ALT-OFFER | kill | buyer-specific:ACSA/Mkhondo/Tshwane/SANRAL/Kokstad-style | Unsanctioned alternative offers — including fixed rates in lieu of a prescribed CPA/escalation formula — kill the whole tender; where allowed at all, only with prior permission and a fully compliant base offer alongside. | fatal | guide-v2 |
| KILL-TWO-ENV | kill | regime:two-envelope | Any price figure appearing in the technical envelope is an explicit disqualification trigger — sweep CVs, org charts, and project descriptions before sealing; two-envelope systems are a ~6% minority but include municipal examples, not only SOE/DFI. | fatal | ocds-9t57fa-165593; ocds-9t57fa-164989; guide-v2 |
| KILL-MULTI-BID | kill | buyer-specific:eThekwini/SANRAL/Eskom | Submitting more than one bid on the same tender (solo or via JV) voids ALL your submissions, and JVs sharing directors/shareholders with another bidder are ineligible — check related-company exposure before two group companies bid. | fatal | ocds-9t57fa-165894; ocds-9t57fa-164220; ocds-9t57fa-165874 |
| KILL-ADDENDA | kill | buyer-specific:Kokstad-style | Failure to sign and return the Record of Addenda with copies attached, or to update the BoQ/pricing where an addendum changes it, is non-responsive at several buyers. | major | guide-v2 |
| SCORE-FUNC-THRESH | score | always | Where functionality is scored, a score below the pack's minimum threshold eliminates the bid before price is considered; thresholds run roughly 40% to over 80% with 70% the mode for formal bids and 50-55% common in municipal panel/RFQ tenders — a sub-60% bar is not a typo. | fatal | ocds-9t57fa-165755; ocds-9t57fa-165539; ocds-9t57fa-164187; guide-v2 |
| SCORE-EVIDENCE | score | always | Functionality claims without the prescribed documentary evidence score zero — no partial credit, no benefit of the doubt; evidence not attached or clearly cross-referenced is deemed not submitted. | major | guide-v2 |
| SCORE-PREF-CLAIM | score | always | Preference points must be explicitly claimed in writing per goal on SBD/MBD 6.1 with the exact named proof attached — a claim without proof scores zero, and proof without a written claim scores zero. | major | guide-v2 |
| SCORE-SYSTEM-8020 | score | always | 80/20 applies up to and including R50 million (all taxes included) and 90/10 above; some packs defer the determination until after opening, so a price near the boundary needs a strategy that survives both systems. | major | guide-v2 |
| SCORE-PRICE-FORMULA | score | always | Lowest responsive price takes all 80 (or 90) points and others score Ps = 80 x (1 - (Pt - Pmin)/Pmin); 2nd/3rd rank retains real award probability via negotiation and cascade provisions. | major | guide-v2 |
| SCORE-TIEBREAK | score | buyer-specific:Bergrivier/DLRRD/Nkomazi-style | Equal total points resolve preference-points-first, then higher functionality score, then a draw of lots — maximise claimable goals even when expecting to win on price. | minor | guide-v2 |
| INFO-OBJ-OVERRIDE | info | buyer-specific:Transnet/Eskom/SANRAL/DBSA/CSIR/PPECB/JW/TNPA | The PPPFA s2(1)(f) "objective criteria" stage lets the buyer pass over the top-ranked bidder for prior poor performance, litigation against the buyer, supplier rotation, financial-ratio risk, insolvency/business rescue, or director fraud charges — winning on points is necessary, not sufficient. | major | guide-v2 |
| INFO-PANEL-2STAGE | info | regime:panel | Panel/framework tenders run a functionality-only entry gate (sometimes with no price submitted at all), then per-order RFQ mini-competitions at 80/20 among panelists, with cascade-to-next-ranked on decline, performance-penalty/greylisting regimes, one-area/lot caps, and exclusion for ignoring RFQ invitations. | major | guide-v2 |
| INFO-CURE-CULTURE | info | always | Buyers split into single-shot and tiered-cure cultures tracking sophistication (mature SOEs/metros tier fatal vs curable-in-48h-7d; small municipal/provincial buyers are single-shot) — never assume a cure window exists. | major | guide-v2 |
| DELTA-V2-01 | gate | always | v2 edit (S3.1): the "B-BBEE never kills the bid" rule holds only for preference claims — check which table the certificate sits in before relying on the still-submit rule, since pass/fail pre-qualification placement disqualifies outright and some goals tables award zero B-BBEE points at all. | fatal | ocds-9t57fa-165629; ocds-9t57fa-164991; ocds-9t57fa-164946; ocds-9t57fa-164923 |
| DELTA-V2-02 | info | always | v2 edit (S5): the pipeline is USUALLY compliance-functionality-price, not always — a sizeable minority of full formal bids run no functionality at all ("FUNCTIONALITY will not be used") and DBSA-style RFPs score price first with a pass/fail risk review after; check the Tender Data's functionality clause explicitly. | major | ocds-9t57fa-165115; ocds-9t57fa-164261; ocds-9t57fa-165894; ocds-9t57fa-164766 |
| DELTA-V2-03 | score | always | v2 edit (S5.1): functionality threshold range widens from "60-80%+" to roughly 40% to over 80% — 70% remains the mode for formal bids but municipal panel/RFQ tenders regularly set 50-55% and one sits at 40 points. | major | ocds-9t57fa-165755; ocds-9t57fa-165539; ocds-9t57fa-164187 |
| DELTA-V2-04 | kill | buyer-specific:Mogale-template | v2 addition (S5.1): some buyers auto-disqualify for a score of zero on ANY criterion or sub-criterion even after the overall threshold is met, and some per-criterion minimums equal the criterion maximum (full marks or dead) — check for this wording separately. | fatal | ocds-9t57fa-165541 |
| DELTA-V2-05 | gate | regime:CIDB | v2 edit (S1.3/S3.2): CIDB "active at close or do not proceed" stays the default, but some buyers accept bidders capable of registration within 21 working days of closing (proof of application at closing, registration by award) — and that CIDB cure clock can exceed the pack's general cure window. | major | ocds-9t57fa-165629; ocds-9t57fa-165711 |
| DELTA-V2-06 | kill | buyer-specific:eThekwini/ERWAT | v2 correction (S7.2): dual-channel buyers split into identical-or-invalid vs hard-copy-governs regimes — at eThekwini and ERWAT the hard copy is the governing/ruling version on mismatch, and at eThekwini the bid is invalid without the hard copy even if uploaded; the guide's "mismatch invalidates (eThekwini)" claim was wrong for that buyer. | fatal | ocds-9t57fa-165894; ocds-9t57fa-165128 |
| DELTA-V2-07 | info | always | v2 edit (S7.2/S9F): always answer validity-extension requests in writing, but check which way the silence-default runs — at most buyers silence = exclusion, at Limpopo DoH silence = acceptance, eThekwini auto-extends 12 months unless you object, and agreeing to extend can bar modifying your tender (Eskom). | major | ocds-9t57fa-164297; ocds-9t57fa-165894; ocds-9t57fa-165629 |
| DELTA-V2-08 | info | buyer-specific:DBSA | v2 footnote (S2 rank 1): DBSA reserves sole discretion to accept a late bid where lateness was caused by DBSA, box access was denied, or a major incident occurred — a narrow exception to record, never to rely on. | minor | ocds-9t57fa-165115 |
| DELTA-V2-09 | info | buyer-specific:SIU | v2 footnote (S2 rank 8 / S7.2): SIU expressly accepts faxed and emailed tender documents — a minority-of-one against 149 "fax will NOT be accepted" mentions; also add "submission channel" to the internal-contradiction sweep since adverts and boilerplate can conflict on the channel itself. | minor | ocds-9t57fa-164363 |
| DELTA-V2-10 | info | buyer-specific:DWS-boilerplate | v2 footnote (S2 rank 12): one older boilerplate expressly permits the bidder "at liberty to qualify his bid" where an alteration is necessary — a caveat only; "never qualify" remains the default. | minor | ocds-9t57fa-164869 |
| DELTA-V2-11 | info | always | v2 edit (S1.4): bid validity guidance widens from 60-120 days to mode 90 with 30-180 all common and outliers to 365 (calendar or business days); some packs ask the bidder to state a validity — if two figures appear, price the longer and clarify in writing. | minor | guide-v2 |
| DELTA-V2-12 | info | regime:CIDB | v2 edit (S1.4): read the clarification cut-off clause every time — CIDB packs run 3-5 working days (not "typically five"), the Tender Data frequently overrides the CIDB default, question and addenda cut-offs can differ, and some windows anchor to the briefing date, not closing. | minor | ocds-9t57fa-164775; ocds-9t57fa-164770; ocds-9t57fa-165894; ocds-9t57fa-165711 |
| DELTA-V2-13 | info | always | v2 edit (S1.1): the pack-type taxonomy gains RFI (market sounding — no returnables, but register interest or lose addenda access) and EOI (non-binding market test up to full three-phase scored pipeline); SOE "RFQs" can carry full scored functionality gates, so the judge-by-content warning is not construction-specific. | major | guide-v2 |
| DELTA-V2-14 | gate | regime:MBD | v2 correction (S3.2): the municipal rates-arrears trigger is not a flat 3 months/90 days — it is buyer-specific down to 1 month (Kouga, including other municipalities' arrears), and some buyers require the clearance only from the recommended bidder; check the certificate's own wording and when it bites. | major | ocds-9t57fa-165524; ocds-9t57fa-165711 |
| DELTA-V2-15 | info | buyer-specific:Transnet/Eskom/SANRAL/DBSA/CSIR/PPECB/JW | v2 addition (S6.3): document the PPPFA s2(1)(f) objective-criteria award override and the related post-scoring security/integrity vetting gates — both can pass over or eliminate the top-scoring bidder, so flag track-record exposure and security-adjacent buyers at go/no-go. | major | guide-v2 |
| DELTA-V2-16 | info | regime:panel | v2 addition (new S6.5): expand the panels bullet into full panel/framework two-stage mechanics — functionality-only entry, per-order 80/20 RFQ mini-competitions, cascades on decline, greylisting, one-area/lot caps, leased-equipment cross-checks — which changes the bid-cost calculus entirely. | major | guide-v2 |
| DELTA-V2-17 | score | always | v2 edit (S6.1 VAT): several buyers DEEM prices above a threshold (R1m-R2.3m) VAT-inclusive regardless of what was written (an exclusive-priced bidder absorbs the 15%); non-vendors pushed past R1m turnover must price VAT in and register with SARS within ~21 days of award; simple RFQs often default VAT-EXCLUSIVE if silent. | major | ocds-9t57fa-164946; guide-v2 |
| DELTA-V2-18 | info | buyer-specific:Mogale-City | v2 addition (S6.1/S8): locality can be a hard eligibility gate, a scored criterion, or a post-award LEVY — Mogale City deducts 2% of every payment from non-local winners with a signed acceptance declaration as a returnable; price it, don't just score it. | major | guide-v2 |
| DELTA-V2-19 | score | buyer-specific:disposal/leasing/income-generating | v2 edit (S6.3): for income-generating tenders the price formula inverts — highest acceptable offer scores full points, Ps = 80/90 x (1 + (Pt - Pmax)/Pmax); best-and-final-offer rounds mean the submitted price is not always the evaluated price, and awards cascade to next-ranked on decline or default. | minor | ocds-9t57fa-165524; ocds-9t57fa-165529 |
| DELTA-V2-20 | gate | always | v2 edit (S4.0/4.4/9B): the form catalog gains new mandatory returnables — POPIA consent, DPIP/FPPO declaration, buyer-branded Integrity Pact, litigation-history form (SANRAL A8), GCC/SCC "ACCEPT ALL" tick-box (failure = disqualification), Certificate of Single Tender Submission, MBD 2 original-only tax clearance, SBD/MBD 3.2 method-of-pricing option (blank = not considered; non-firm schedules with escalation exist, so soften "firm prices only"), MBD 6.4 local-content points, and lot/field tick-box tables (untick = disqualified). | fatal | ocds-9t57fa-164297; guide-v2 |
| DELTA-V2-21 | kill | buyer-specific:eThekwini/SANRAL/Eskom/SABC | v2 addition (S2 tail / S3.2): one bid per entity — a second submission (solo or via JV) voids ALL your submissions and director/shareholder overlap with another bidder is ineligible; plus buyer-specific cooling-off bans for ex-employees (SABC: 12 months, 5 years if dismissed). | fatal | ocds-9t57fa-165894; ocds-9t57fa-164220; ocds-9t57fa-165874 |
| DELTA-V2-22 | info | always | v2 edit (S3.3): subcontracting stances gain "consent-gated by default" (GCC boilerplate) and "100% pass-through banned" (Eskom); the boilerplate cap reads 25% OR 30% depending on the pack; Transnet penalises undisclosed subcontracting up to 10% of contract value; CIDB CSDG/CPG gazetted goals auto-trigger at thresholds; mandatory 30% quotas can bite from as low as R4m. | major | guide-v2 |
| DELTA-V2-23 | info | always | v2 edit (S3.4/S6.1): performance security is 5-10% OR a flat Rand sum within 14-21 days, often replaced by a 5% payment-reduction retention under ~R1m; add most-favoured-customer clauses, no-arithmetic-correction buyers (submitted total final), price-declaration forms governing over the schedule, and withdrawal-after-acceptance liability equal to the re-procurement price gap. | major | guide-v2 |
| DELTA-V2-24 | info | always | v2 edit (S7.1/S7.2): briefings — some CIDB packs hold none, headers and body can conflict on compulsory status (clarify in writing), some buyers publish a doors-close grace period; submission — per-buyer portal traps (file-size caps, zip required at DBSA vs banned at Eskom, PDF-only, cloud-link rules, filename rules), document fees run R300-R2,300+, and the handwritten-only rule is a recurring municipal template that can be scoped to just the BoQ — check, never assume either way. | major | guide-v2 |
